source: 8 Saka cecay hahekalan a Krisciyang patirengay to taˈarawan, mapolong a romadiw pahemek ci Yihofaan.
target: 8 First-century Christians set a pattern of praising God together in song.

source: 18 O ciraramoday Krisciyang ano maolahay ci Yihofaan tatodongen Cingra.
target: 18 Accordingly, married couples who love Jehovah’s ways imitate him.

source: 17 Ano sakacakataw i pihodop ci Yihofaan, makahi kiso micada to adihayay a sapahatatanam han?
target: 17 Do you desire to receive further training so as to be better equipped to carry out your sacred service?

source: Sasamaan kita miremo to ciˈangiay, mahemek a romadiw pakahemek ci Yihofaan hani?
target: How can we overcome the fear of using our voice to sing praises to Jehovah?

source: Samaanay kita padama cangranan mafanaˈ ci Yihofaan ato araaw Ningra hani?
target: What can you do to help such ones come to know Jehovah and his purpose?

source: Ano misiˈayaw kita to pasangaray a sapalifet i nokaˈorip i, sasamaan misamacay ko minengnengan ci Yihofaan hani?
target: And how can we make sure that our eyes remain fixed on him as we face life’s complex challenges?

source: O micadaayto kiso to inoˈa kaemangay, anca sapicadaaw to inoˈa tamdaw, ano sapitongalaw to kalawidang ci Yihofaan, wa misamaan kiso to demak hani?
target: Baptized young ones and those who are contemplating baptism, how can you strengthen your relationship with Jehovah?

source: Soˈlin mapaciˈci malaliyas to fafahi ato wawa, kawra maharateng to padotocay madimadiay kako aci Mariya ci Yihofaan, masayaray ko falocoˈ ako.
target: Although my wife and daughters were far away, I drew comfort from knowing that Maria and I had remained loyal to Jehovah.

source: Ano sakacaaw ka palak no kalawidang ci Yihofaan i, wa samaan ko hademak ita hani?
target: What course of action is vital if we are to protect our special friendship with Jehovah?

source: 10 Ci Filip aci Mari padotoc a misamacay mihodop ci Yihofaan, malifokay nangra ko sapafeli ni Yihofa a sapalemed.
target: 10 In response to their efforts to maintain a spiritual outlook on their situation, Jehovah blessed Philip and Mary in many ways.

source: Ci Mosi aci Aron samaanay paihkal to midopoay ko niyah ci Yihofaan?
target: How did Moses and Aaron seize opportunities to show that they were on Jehovah’s side?

source: O cecacecay midokoay to Kawas a tamdaw, makalimay cangra pakayni ci Yihofaan a ciˈicel, tanoktok a mihodop ci Yihofa.
target: All of us desire to be made strong by Jehovah and to remain firm in our worship.

source: 15 Mafiyoray no waywayan no tao ci Mosi, telocto cowa ka padotoc mihalamham ci Yihofaan.
target: 15 Moses allowed the actions of others to distract him from keeping his eyes fixed on Jehovah.

source: Samaan kita miliyas to pakayni i raraw no tao a mapalak ko kalalaˈed ci Yihofaan hani?
target: How can we avoid damaging our relationship with Jehovah even though we may be dealing with the mistakes of others?

source: Tada mahemekay ci Aan mipadang ci Paulaan padadotoc a midoko ci Yihofaan.
target: Ann too is happy, for she has been like a spiritual mother to Paula.

source: Tahiraay i patay ko kamadimadi no wama wina ako a mihodop ci Yihofaan, mitokelay kako militemoh cangranan i faelohay hekal.
target: My parents both died faithful to Jehovah, and I look forward to welcoming them back in a much better world.

source: Mitiˈeray Kiso ci Yihofaan a Milimek Han?
target: Are You Taking Refuge in Jehovah?

source: 10 Ikor, misafelitay ci Yihofaan ko Israil tamdaw, cowato pidama to matatodongay a pihakelongan.
target: 10 Over time, most Israelites claiming to serve Jehovah turned their backs on him and on true worship.

source: Ci Solomon midemakay to maanan a pakararaway ci Yihofaan a demak hani?
target: To what extreme did Solomon offend Jehovah?

source: O micawmaˈan iso a tamdaw wa samaan ko pilingat to kalawidang iso aci Yihofaan?
target: What effect are your associates having on your relationship with Jehovah?

source: 11 Ano midoko kiso ci Yihofaan wa ira ko ˈalomanay ngaˈayay a widang, naitiniay icowacowa pala cangra, o roma cowaho ka soˈaraw iso!
target: 11 It is no exaggeration to say that as a worshipper of Jehovah, you have the very best kind of friends, and they are all around the world.

source: O kapah no kasakopang misaˈicel pakahemek ci Yihofaan, wa ngaˈay milifok to haepoc no niyah.
target: Young people in the congregation benefit themselves if they focus on pleasing Jehovah.

source: 11 Wa ngaˈay kita misamaan mitodong ci Yihofaan, miliyas to waywayan no pasifanaˈay to Rikec ato Farisay tamdaw hani?
target: 11 How can we avoid the attitude of the scribes and Pharisees and imitate Jehovah?

source: Malecaday toya mitiliday to ˈOlic a tamdaw kita, adihayay ko lalangian milekal “pahemek ci Yihofaan” halo pakalalok to romaroma tamdaw pakahemek i Cingranan!
target: Like the writer of Psalm 147, do you not have many good reasons to cry out “Praise Jah!”

source: Ano samanayto ko tatodong ni Mosi, ora sowal ningra paihkalay to cowa ka ngodo ko niyah ci Yihofaan, samanen cowa panokayen ningra ci Yihofaan koniya sapidemak to kafahkaˈan a ˈicel.
target: Those words indicated a gross lack of respect for Jehovah as the true Source of that miracle.

source: Onini lalakaw wa milengo to samaanay hano patafang kita to kalimelaan a dafong a paˈodingar ci Yihofaan, ato mihaen ko demak ita wa milifok to manan sapalemed.
target: This article will consider why and how we benefit from honoring Jehovah with our valuable things.

source: Soˈlin wa awa ko tolas no toki ita noikor, pakayniay ci Yihofaan a sifanaˈ cowa ko mamaemin ita a minanam.
target: Even with an eternity of time, we can always learn more about Jehovah.

source: 19 ˈAlomanay kapah i kasakopang pakaremoay to pasangaray, misarocod to falocoˈ mihodop ci Yihofaan, citodongay to papakahemeken no mita.
target: 19 Young people in the congregation deserve warm commendation for the way they meet these challenges and for being determined to focus their lives on serving Jehovah.

source: 21. (1) Iraay ko samaanay a hrateng ni Tafiti ci Yihofaan hani?
target: 21. (a) How did David feel toward Jehovah?

source: 19 Mahaen o masowalay i fafekang a tinakoan, ano misaˈicel kita a midemak, ira ko pakasoˈlin no falocoˈ mitala ci Yihofaan, wa ngaˈayto kita mitafo to rihadayay falocoˈ.
target: 19 As these examples show, if we make the best of our circumstances and wait confidently on Jehovah, we will maintain our inner peace.

source: 8 Kaemangho ci Yis milifetayto to patay no salawina.
target: 8 In his younger years, Jesus no doubt had to deal with the deaths of family members and acquaintances.

source: Pakayni to nokaˈorip no kaemanganho ni Yis, o matiliday ni Matay aci Luka hano caka hahecad?
target: Why do Matthew’s and Luke’s accounts differ as to Jesus’ early life?

source: Somowalay ci Yis to cecay tinakoan, milengo to cecay sidaˈitay a Samariya tamdaw samanay paihkal to adayayay.
target: Jesus’ illustration of the neighborly Samaritan vividly portrays what it means to show mercy.

source: Mihaenay, palahad kita to harateng ni Yis ato waywayan, tada o kalimelaan.
target: For these reasons, it becomes clear how important it is to learn to think as Jesus does.

source: Sanay kora sinael: “Nengneng sa ci Yis to finawlan i, saadayay sa cingra, nawhani marawraw cangra a matiya o malafelay a siri to awaay ko pakaenay.”
target: That verse says: “On seeing the crowds, [Jesus] felt pity for them, because they were skinned and thrown about like sheep without a shepherd.”

source: Nikawrira, cowa ka ciharateng ci Yosif, mihaen to tireng ni Yis.
target: But that is not what Joseph had in mind for Jesus.

source: Kalimelaan i padamaan ningra ko ˈalomanay, cipinang to malaˈosiay ko piliyaw ni Yis maˈorip to ˈOlic 16:10.
target: More to the point, the people acknowledged that Psalm 16:10 was fulfilled when Jesus was resurrected from the dead.

source: Samaanay ci Yis misiˈayaw to misakakinihay?
target: How did Jesus deal with prejudice?

source: Pakayni i matatodongay a pirikec ato ciepocay a pasifanaˈ, mikitini taˈarawan ni Yis mananamay ita ko maanan?
target: What are some lessons about appropriate discipline and effective teaching that we can learn from Jesus?

source: 11 O roma sapicowat to kalacecay a pakayraan i, dotimen ko tatodong no tahapinangan a dafong i Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Saˈopo.
target: 11 A second way we can promote unity is by reflecting on the meaning of the emblems used at the Memorial.

source: Iraayho ko maanan a wacay paihkal to sowal ni Yis i, “soˈlinen ako pasowal kiso anini” hani?
target: What supports our understanding of what Jesus said?

source: ˈOlic 118:22, iraay ko maanan kalaliting to piliyaw ni Yis a maˈorip?
target: How did Psalm 118:22 point to Jesus’ resurrection?

source: Pakayni i raramod pasowalay ci Yis to maanan a limoˈot hani?
target: What important advice about marriage did Jesus give?

source: Isaka 2017 miheca, oni tolo a naniyaroˈan, makalitosaay ko tamdaw, mirienangay to Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Saˈopo, ora mirienangay tosaay tingroh ko kaˈaloman to mitosilay salikaka.
target: As a result, in 2017, these three towns had a combined Memorial attendance of almost double the number of publishers —or half the entire population.

source: (2) Misamaanay hano ira ko hatiniay a harateng ni Yis hani?
target: (See opening picture.) (b) Why did Jesus respond in that way?

source: Sanay ko caˈof ni Yis: ‘Cowa ko noni hekal ko Hongti Kitakit ako.’
target: Jesus answered: “My Kingdom is no part of this world.”

source: Iraay ko timolo iso mihayi to o hongti iso ci Yis han?
target: Do you have the courage to acknowledge Jesus as your King?

source: Mikitini i sowal ni Yis wa ngaˈay micada kita to sapakalalok.
target: We should all be encouraged by that promise.

source: Kawra, ci Yis palimoˈot to nisawawaan: “Pinaˈon to tamod no Farisay a tamdaw ato tamod ni Hiroti,” sanay.
target: So Jesus warned his disciples: “Keep your eyes open; look out for the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.”

source: Tahirato mapolong ko tamdaw mahemek a mitengil to sowal ni Yis: “Katayni kamo o mapalemeday no Wama ako a tamdaw a micomod to nikowanan no Wama ako a kitakit oya nipatalaan to saki tamowanan nai satapangan no nipisangaˈ to hekal a kamaroˈan.” —Matay 25:34.
target: The rejoicing of Jehovah’s earthly worshippers will know no bounds when they hear Jesus’ words: “Come, you who have been blessed by my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the founding of the world.” —Matt. 25:34.

source: (2) O lipahak ni Yis samaanay malo lipahak no mita hani?
target: (b) How will Jesus’ joy become ours?

source: 17 Ci Yis mihadidiay a mitala.
target: 17 Jesus likewise has been willing to wait.

source: Toni tosa lalakaw, wa maˈaraw ita to samaanay ci Yis, pasifanaˈ to mikotoday cingranan a makelec, halo piremo to masakakinihay a harateng.
target: In these two articles, we will see how Christ taught his followers to become united and to overcome the prejudices that tend to divide.

source: Samaanay micada ci Yis to mihakelongay cingranan a tamdaw?
target: How did Jesus respond to the condition of the crowds who followed him?

source: 17 Aninito anca noikor, o sakayat no Hongti ci Yis Kristo wa ngaˈay padama kitaanan.
target: 17 As shown by his active direction, our enthroned King, Jesus Christ, is definitely looking to the future.

source: O olah ni Yis pafeliay kitaanan to haˈicel a tanektek, soˈlin tahalifa to pades, sapalak anca matoled, macariraw, cowa ko raranikay a misawad.
target: Jesus’ love has the power to sustain us and to motivate us not to give up, even in the face of such trials as disasters, persecution, personal disappointments, or gnawing anxiety.

source: Ngaˈayay pikayat ni Yis,
target: We obey Christ Jesus’ clear command;

source: Pasowalan ni Pawlo aci Silas cingra: “Pasoˈlinen ko tapang a Yis ta mapaˈorip kiso,” sanay. —Dmak 16:25-34.
target: They told him: “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will get saved.” —Acts 16:25-34.

source: O olah ni Yis samaanay mifiyor kitaanan?
target: How can Jesus’ love fortify us?

source: Kawra, palimoˈotay ci Yis, o pakayniay i cowa pisateked a lalangian kita, misawidang to ikakarayanay a widang.
target: However, Jesus urged his followers to make friends in heaven for unselfish purposes.

source: Soˈlinay mahapinangay ci Yis, kawra cowa ka haen o milongocan ni Mariya ko mifekaday a demak.
target: Recognition did come, but not in the way Mary may have expected.

source: Samaanay ci Yis mitodong to Wama ningra ciharateng to tao hani?
target: How did Jesus show godlike love?

source: Miocoran ci Yis
target: It was a willing sacrifice

source: ˈAyaw no somowal ci Yis to kilang no fadisosoˈa sapatinako pasowalay to tarokos: ‘Pafelien ako kamo to dipayal no mako.’
target: Earlier on that last evening before his death, Jesus told his apostles: “I give you my peace.”

source: Somowalay ci Yis to salikoray lintad noni hekal, patinakoay to linkim, pakalalokay to madimadiay a Krisciyang.
target: The parable of the talents, given in Jesus’ prophecy about the conclusion of the system of things, encourages faithfulness.

source: O pinengneng ni Yis ato Farisay tamdaw to ciraraway tamdaw samanay caka hecad? Tadtaden.
target: Contrast the way Jesus and the Pharisees viewed sinners.

source: 16 Soˈlinay o tarokos mikitini taˈarawan ni Yis, minanam to mamaolah to “masakenaay tamdaw.”
target: 16 Clearly, the apostles did learn from Jesus’ example to love “all sorts of men.”

source: Kawra, o sapietan to payci a lalosidan no pidoyongan, sanay ko harateng ningra, marariday pakatawa cingra: “Sakafanaˈaw kako to hakowaay ko lifon ni Yis a mitosil.”
target: Father loved the Bible and read it to us on Sunday mornings, but he viewed religion as a money-making scheme and often jokingly asked, “I wonder who paid Jesus for his preaching and teaching?”

source: * O nisawawaan ni Yis wa ciheci to maanan a heci hani?
target: * What, then, is the fruitage that Christ’s followers need to bear?

source: Samanay ci Yis paihekal to caka olah ko niyah mikapot to mirikecay?
target: How did Jesus show that he had no interest in political movements?

source: (Luka 4:25-27) Cowa ka cecay aca ko Samariya fafahiyan mitosilan ni Yis, materekayho i niyaroˈ no Samariya to tosa romiˈad cingra, samanen saka cipinangaw ko itiraay tamdaw to mitenakan ni Yis a lihaf. —Yohani 4:21-24, 40.
target: (Luke 4:25-27) And Jesus not only preached to a Samaritan woman but he spent two days in a Samaritan town because of the people’s interest in his message. —John 4:21-24, 40.

source: Ci Yis mala hongti.
target: He rules by your decree.

source: 8 Masowal ni Yis ko Wama ningra i, sanay ko sowal: “O caay ka ciheci a caˈang ako a maemin i, ketonen no Wama a mifalah.”
target: 8 Speaking about his Father, Jesus stated: “He takes away every branch in me not bearing fruit.”

source: Samaanay ci Yis pakalalok to tarokos hani? Samaanayho cingra pakalalok ci Pitiroan hani?
target: What encouragement did Jesus give to his apostles and to Peter in particular?

source: 15 O mikiˈokan ni Yis a pasalat, o sangaˈayay a pasalat, mikikakaay to micangacangan no ˈalomanay to saka pasalataw i mikowanay demak.
target: 15 Clearly, the freedom that Jesus promised his disciples is far superior to the social or political freedom that most people yearn for today.

source: 9 Ci Yosif, Rahap, ci Yis ato tarokos, patahekalay to timolo, onini ilalinikay a ˈicel, mansa matatodong ko demak nangra.
target: 9 Joseph, Rahab, Jesus, and the apostles displayed an inner strength that motivated them to perform good works.

source: Misaheciay ci Yis patahekal to olah no Wama ningra.
target: Jesus’ love perfectly reflected the love his Father shows.

source: Ikor no patay ni Yis, patikolay ci Pitiro to mifotingay a tayal.
target: After Jesus’ death, Peter returned to his former occupation —fishing.

source: Makahiyay ci Yis midemak to salaenoay a tayal, misakareteng to tao, patireng to taˈarawan ita.
target: Jesus set the pattern in honoring others by performing the lowliest of tasks.

source: Sowal ni Yis, o makoracay tamdaw, iraay ko tatodong a mipiliˈ to milikong, ikor miliyaw a ciraramod.
target: Jesus said that the innocent one would have a basis for getting a divorce and then be free to remarry.

source: Samanay ci Yis a misiˈayaw to masakakinihay harateng hani?
target: How did Jesus deal with them?

source: 12 Ci Yis patahekalay to soˈlinay olah i tamdaw.
target: 12 Jesus showed great love for others.

source: Samanay ci Yis malo ‘taˈenengan a fakeloh no lomaˈ’ hani?
target: How could Jesus become “the chief cornerstone”?

source: (2) Samanay a mahapinang ita to pacaˈofan ni Yihofa ko satolon ni Yis?
target: (b) What shows that Jehovah has answered Jesus’ prayer?

source: Ya mapatay ci Lacarus i, samaanay paihekal ci Yis to siniˈada to tamdaw?
target: How did Jesus show empathy when Lazarus died?

source: Dotimen ako ko taˈarawan ni Yis ikor, cowato ka sikoren ako koni demak.
target: After reflecting on what Jesus would have done, I decided to let the matter go and not make an issue of it.

source: Itiniho i fafekang no sera ci Yis mitosil i, pasifanaˈay to nisawawaan to taˈenengan a kimad, padama cangranan cipinang to maanan a waywayan ato demakan, wa ira ko masamanay a minaroˈan.
target: Throughout his ministry, Jesus taught basic truths to help his disciples recognize the consequences of certain attitudes or actions.

source: 18 ˈAyaw no kinafalah ci Yis to ˈorip, na pasowalay to nisawawaan, o wawa no tamdaw “tolo a romiˈad, tolo a dadaya i lalomaˈ no sera.”
target: 18 However, recall that Jesus had earlier told his followers: “The Son of man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.”

source: 7 Anini, o misakakinihay harateng no ˈalomanay tamdaw pasangarayto a salofen, mahecaday i romiˈaday ni Yis.
target: 7 Feelings of prejudice in our time can be deeply ingrained, just as they were in Jesus’ day.

source: (Paˈarawan 17:12-14) Mihaenay, iˈayaw no “tayni” ci Yis misaˈopo to mapasimalay a Krisciyang tayra i kakarayan a Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Saˈopo, o salikorayto koniya Piharatengan a Saˈopo.
target: 17:12-14) The last Memorial that is observed prior to this gathering of the anointed to heaven will be the final one, for Jesus will have ‘come.’

source: Licayan ni Yis ko tarokos wa mahecad to roma tamdaw a miliyas cingraanan hokira, tangsolay pacaˈof ci Pitiro: “Tapangaw, i cimaanan kami a palawina saw?
target: When Jesus asked the apostles if they wanted to leave, Peter immediately replied: “Lord, whom shall we go away to?

source: (Marko 1:40, 41) Mahecaday ci Yis to Wamaan ningra makalimay mipadang to marorayay a tamdaw. —Yohani 14:9.
target: (Mark 1:40, 41) Jesus perfectly reflected his Father’s personality by his desire to help those in need. —John 14:9.

source: 9 Ya mitosil ci Yis i hekal i, cipinangay to falocoˈ no tamdaw, siniˈada i cangranan.
target: 9 When Jesus embarked on his ministry, it was with a remarkable depth of insight and fellow feeling.

source: 17 Nikawrira, cowa ko lawla aca ko kaciharatengan ni Yis.
target: 17 Yet, Jesus did not immerse himself in a life of pleasure.

source: Pasowalan ako cingra: “Sowal ni Yis o ngaˈayay lihaf no Hongti Kitakit wa mapaedef i polong no hekal, awaay ko papakaconged a tamdaw.”
target: I replied, “Jesus said that the good news of the Kingdom WILL be preached in all the nations, and no one can stop it.”

source: 15 Itiniho i hekal ci Yis i, cowa ka ciharateng to sapihaydaaw no ˈaˈideman no pihakelongan ato tapang no mirikecay.
target: 15 Jesus did not crave to be honored by the religious or political leaders of his day.

source: Sanay ko sowal ni Yis cangraanan: “O cacilafo kamo o misamangahay ko demak a pasifanaˈay to Rikec ato Farisay a tamdaw.
target: He told them to their face: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites!

source: Kawra, mikitini kita i sapatinako ni Yis, mahapinangay to mitokelay ci Yihofa kitaanan mihaen to demak.
target: Yet, this illustration teaches us what Jehovah expects.

source: Samanay paihekal ci Yis, cowa ko mamicangacang cingra to mirikecay a fadangalan i hekal hani?
target: How did Jesus make clear that he did not seek political power on earth?

source: Ci Yihofa, ci Yis ato madimadiay a coyoh wa padama kitaanan.
target: We are backed by Jehovah, Jesus, and the faithful angels.

source: Itiniho i hekal ci Yis i, samaanan ni Yihofa mihayda cingra hani?
target: While Jesus was on earth, how did Jehovah show his approval of his Son?

source: Mikayatan no coyoh ci Filipan, tayra i ˈaˈayaw noniya Iciyopiya tamdaw, ‘milasil to ngaˈayay ratoh ni Yis cingranan.’
target: Prompted by Jehovah’s angel, Philip approached the Ethiopian and “declared to him the good news about Jesus.”

source: 3 Mitosilan ni Yis ko ˈalomanay a Yutaya tamdaw, tokel nangra sapiliyasaw to pikowan no Loma.
target: 3 Many Jews to whom Jesus preached longed for independence from Rome.

source: Misamaanay hano pakasoˈlin kita, mamihinom kitanan ci Yis?
target: Why can we be confident that Jesus will provide comfort?

source: Samaanay ci Yis patahekal to olah i tamdaw hani?
target: How did Jesus show love for others?

source: (2) Samaanay ci Yis padama to tamdaw milowid to misakakinihay a harateng?
target: (b) How did Jesus teach a lesson in overcoming racial prejudice?

source: Micadaay ko nisawawaan ni Yis to maanan a pisakahemaw hani?
target: What prejudice did Jesus’ followers experience?

source: Maharek somowal ci Yis toniya sapatinako, dotoc misaka dademakay to sapairasol no ˈOlic 118:22.
target: Jesus followed that illustration with a reference to the prophetic statement at Psalm 118:22, which he quoted.

source: 12 Hofocento ci Yis, cowa ka pasayra i ˈaˈideman no Yirusalim ato Piclihim ci Yihofa a milasil toniya demak, tano kafahkaˈan a pakayraan mifanaˈ to tamdaw to mihofocanto ci Yis.
target: 12 When Mary eventually gave birth to Jesus, Jehovah did not honor any of the prominent officials or rulers in Jerusalem and Bethlehem by letting them know what had happened.

source: O misowalan ni Yis a Lakoing toya mararaway, sasamaan malaˈosi hani?
target: How would the promise that Jesus made about Paradise be fulfilled?

source: 5 Samaanay ko pipacaˈof ni Yihofa to picada ni Yis to inoˈ hani?
target: 5 How did Jehovah respond to Jesus’ baptism?

source: Sowal ni Yis, “O sapafeliaw no Wama to ningitangitan namo Cingraan a maamaan pakayni i ngangan ako.”
target: Jesus stated: “No matter what you ask the Father in my name, he [will] give it to you.”

source: Samanay ko pinengneng ni Yis to pasataay?
target: What balanced position on taxation did Jesus recommend?

source: Cowa pasowal ci Yis to malaˈosiay kora sapakokot hokira.
target: Jesus does not indicate whether the accusation was valid.

source: Makelec a malacecay ko nisawawaan wa ngaˈay misawacay, o na miocoran ni Yihofa ci Yis tayni i hekal.
target: Their unity would give a powerful witness, offering clear evidence that Jehovah had sent Jesus to the earth to do God’s will.

source: TIYA malacafay ci Yis to tarokos a komaen to saikoray a lafi i, ciharatengayto wa ngaˈay cangra mitafo to makelecay hakiya.
